evidence.detail: The class owns BufferPool, IntBufferCache and two FloatBufferCache instances and exposes the older 117 HD ModelCache get/put vertex, normal and UV data; pooled typed-buffer acquisition; makeRoom balancing; clear; and shutdown behavior.

Exact v308 preserves the distinctive 32-bit fallback diagnostic "defaulting model cache to 512MiB due to non 64-bit client" plus the buffer-room and physical-memory limit/failure diagnostics associated with the older ModelCache implementation.

The same class also extends LinkedHashMap<Integer, rs/k/b/c>, where rs/k/b/c is independently identified as ModelData. This matches the newer public 117 HD ModelCache generation that extends LinkedHashMap<Integer, ModelData>.

Public 117 HD history contains both ModelCache forms found together in v308: an older native BufferPool/IntBufferCache/FloatBufferCache manager with the exact 512MiB fallback, and a newer LinkedHashMap<Integer, ModelData> cache. SpawnPK v308 combines those two ModelCache responsibilities into one class.

proposals.note: ModelCache is supported by two complementary public 117 HD generations whose responsibilities are merged in exact v308; this does not claim byte-for-byte source equivalence.

evidence.detail: The class owns one model reference, six integer hash fields and a reusable static int[4] hash workspace.

Its color/cache hash combines the six stored hashes with model override amount, hue, saturation and luminance through Arrays.hashCode; its second hash combines Arrays.hashCode results from model integer arrays.

Public 117 HD ModelHasher preserves the same model reference, the same six color/transparency/texture hash roles and an Arrays.hashCode-based color/batch hash generation using model overrides and model arrays.

The exact-v308 setter path is locally simplified relative to the public revision and does not visibly recompute all six stored fields, so the identity is lineage-backed rather than asserted as source-equivalent.

proposals.note: ModelHasher is strongly lineage-corroborated but receives 0.998 confidence because v308 locally simplified the public setter/hash preparation path.

evidence.detail: The class has exactly two instance fields: int[] model color data and int face count, with fluent setters and a face-count getter.
Its color lookup returns colors[(face * 4) + index], fixing the four-integers-per-face metadata layout.
rs/k/b/e stores these values directly as the value type of its LinkedHashMap<Integer, rs/k/b/c> model metadata cache.
Public 117 HD source preserves class ModelData with the same int[] colors + int faceCount fields, fluent setters and exact colors[(face * 4) + index] accessor.
